name: GT-mask memory-value repair headroom in frozen official SAM2
scope: TRAIN-only oracle diagnostic; no learned method, validation selection or deployable efficacy claim

prior_work.idea: The published code compares values encoded from a perturbed mask (ref_v) with values encoded from GT (v_2), using channel-wise KL. This diagnostic does not train that loss or reproduce the full RDE architecture.
prior_work.project_difference: MemSAM v2 changed features before memory encoding without consistency supervision; MAVOS contrastive values used FG/BG SupCon without GT-memory targets. Run142 used GT BOX prompts with MedSAM2, not this value-only intervention.

data.prompt: First labelled frame; native propagation thereafter
data.targets: For N frames after reindexing the first labelled prompt to0, select sorted unique targets 8+floor((N-1-8)*i/2), i=0,1,2. If N<9 report skipped-too-short. Selection never uses model outcomes or target-mask contents.
data.trajectory: One fixed native trajectory per video; interventions are read-only query replays. Never write oracle predictions into the native bank.
data.status: Exploratory; PolypGen informed previous development. Sequence independence does not establish patient independence.

arms.native: Native query replay with its unchanged predicted bank
arms.identity_values: Same pre-v_proj value integration, replacing spatial values by identical native values
arms.mask_only: For every selected NON-conditioning memory frame, re-encode the same source image features with its GT mask and its native object score; replace only that frame's unpositioned spatial values in all four reads
arms.mask_and_presence: Same oracle values but also use GT source presence under the author's mask-input score convention; diagnostic secondary arm

held_fixed: Native spatial keys and attention projections
native bank and all subsequent native predictions
native_encoding_gate: Re-encode each selected predicted-mask source from its stored low-res mask and native score with the author's own memory encoder. Require bitwise equality to its stored bfloat16 memory and positions before using a GT teacher. No approximation or tolerance fallback.

engineering_gate.target: Local frame8 only, using full seven-frame memory
checks: identity value wrapper matches native bitwise
all four layers and selected spans match
pre-k_proj key inputs unchanged for every oracle arm
native replay after oracle equals before

analysis: Sequence is the unit; mean target scores within each sequence, then equal-sequence mean. Report both predeclared oracle-minus-native contrasts, sequence bootstrap95% intervals (10000 draws), Wilcoxon/Holm, wins/ties/losses and leave-one-sequence-out sensitivity. Report all planned cases, skips and empty-target denominators.

decision.primary: mask_only minus native on present targets
decision.consider_future_training_only_if: At least8 sequences have present targets; equal-sequence Dice gain>=0.01; bootstrap lower bound>0; wins>=60% of eligible sequences; every leave-one-sequence-out mean remains positive; no additional false alarms on sampled GT-empty targets. If no empty target exists, mark false-alarm assessment unavailable and require it in any later pilot.
decision.secondary_not_fallback: A gain only in mask_and_presence does not pass the mask-only repair hypothesis. Interpret source-presence and mask effects separately.
decision.stop: Any integrity failure stops before full diagnostic. Failed primary headroom stops this defined mask-only value-repair candidate; do not train it to seek a positive result.
decision.limit: This is not a global oracle upper bound, a learned selector, a cohort efficacy result, proof of convergence or a publication claim. Passing can motivate a separately frozen learned comparison only; it does not reopen the old pilot test.

reuse: Pinned native SAM2 memory encoder and supplied-mask convention
